records.brief: An original editorial-marketing symbol: a deep-magenta MEGAPHONE whose broad front cone is formed by one sculpted blush-paper fold, with a single lavender fountain-PEN NIB integrated diagonally along its body. It must immediately communicate writing/refining advertising messages, not a decorative flower, generic book or chat app. Only megaphone + paper fold + clear pen nib, one coherent compact silhouette. Magenta #782859, blush #F9DAE0 and soft lavender #D6B0FC. No letters, calligraphy, speech text, approval checks, decorative petals or national symbols. Refined tactile surfaces, minimal fine detail.

records.brief: A clear tenancy-evidence review symbol: an upright pale-ivory RENTAL AGREEMENT folio whose top edge is clipped by a bold dark-plum HOUSE-shaped paperclip/roof. On the folio are three short recessed clause lines and a muted rose vertical chronological rail with three large evidence nodes. A small rose inspection lens integrates into the lower edge, visibly inspecting the last clause. House/document/evidence review must read as one balanced icon, not a judge or a real-estate-sales logo. Plum #3C283B, pale lavender ivory #E3D7E9, muted rose #BE8E9C. No gavel, key, scales, court seal, writing, numbers or approval tick. Strong broad forms; lens subordinate to the rental dossier.

records.concept: A quiet breathing and wellbeing pause
records.brief: A serene wellbeing-practice symbol: one elegantly simplified adult human figure seated cross-legged in a calm upright breathing posture, head a small pale-sage sphere, shoulders/arms and legs formed by broad eucalyptus-teal ceramic curves. Hands rest openly on the knees, no ritual mudras. One airy pale-sage OPEN ARC behind the shoulders suggests a slow expanding breath and generous personal space. Clear human breathing/relaxation practice, not a heart-care badge, face mask, medical icon or abstract loop. Teal #4A7480, sage #AEC7BB and off-white #F0F4F1. No face details, clothing texture, religious symbols, lotus petals, clinical cross, ECG, brain anatomy or text. Compact dignified silhouette, not a toy mascot.
